title: Reduce food waste at Maple Cafe
context: A fictional campus cafe discards unsold sandwiches every afternoon.
need: Help the manager plan daily sandwich quantities with less waste.
users: Cafe manager and morning shift staff.
data_materials: The synthetic brief assumes a sample CSV of daily sales and waste can be supplied at kickoff; no dataset is bundled.
constraints: Two-week project; use synthetic data and free tools only.
expected_result: A spreadsheet or dashboard recommending daily production quantities.
success_criteria: Compare recommendations against a simple prior-week baseline on sample data and explain the waste tradeoffs.
contact: Fictional cafe manager Alex, alex@maple.example; weekly 20-minute video check-in.

title: Make library room bookings easier
context: A fictional community library manages study-room bookings by email.
need: Reduce duplicate bookings and repetitive staff replies.
data_materials: Invented booking examples and room capacity descriptions will be prepared with the team.
expected_result: A clickable booking prototype and a short staff workflow guide.
contact: Fictional librarian Morgan, morgan@library.example; questions by email.

title: Improve volunteer shift coordination
context: A fictional neighborhood charity coordinates volunteer shifts in several chat groups.
need: Give coordinators one place to see unfilled shifts.
expected_result: A simple shift-board prototype using invented volunteers.
contact: Fictional coordinator Sam, sam@charity.example; one kickoff call.

title: Understand bike shop customer feedback
context: A fictional bike repair shop receives scattered feedback after repairs.
need: Find out why some customers do not return.

title: Track reusable packaging returns
context: A fictional meal delivery startup lends reusable containers but tracks returns on paper.
need: Show staff which containers are outstanding and when they were issued.
data_materials: The team can generate 50 fictional container records from the described workflow.
constraints: Three-week prototype; no real customer addresses or payment details.
expected_result: A container checkout and return tracker with an overdue list.
success_criteria: Record and return all 50 sample containers without duplicate identifiers; correctly flag overdue items.
